evals.name: current-version-and-project
evals.prompt: 当前打开的是哪个 Wwise 版本和哪个工程？只读告诉我实际结果。
evals.expected_output: 通过 Skill 的固定查询入口连接真实 WAAPI，返回实际 Wwise 版本和当前工程，而不是照抄保存配置。

checks.text: The fresh Codex session contains no memory context.
The assistant loads the installed waapi-skill.
The assistant uses the Skill's fixed executable gateway before repository-wide discovery.
The assistant does not write temporary code, use inline Python, or directly construct WaapiClient business logic.
Dispatcher evidence proves live getInfo and getProjectInfo calls.
The final response reports the oracle Wwise version and project identity.
